coverage_title: Co-op, one feature at a time
overview_intro: Play [Early Beta 17](https://github.com/DooDesch-Mods/MMORPGTycoon2-Multiplayer/releases/tag/v0.1.0-beta.17) today. Development progress below is separate from the download. Each row names one feature and its exact scope.

features.name: Host a Steam lobby
features.scope: Open a lobby from the Multiplayer window.

features.name: Join a lobby
features.scope: Join the Host and receive the selected world.

features.name: Create a shared world
features.scope: The Host uses the original new-world wizard while the other player waits.

features.name: Send session messages
features.scope: Send and read basic messages in the Multiplayer window.

features.name: Pause together
features.scope: Pause or resume the shared world from either player.

features.name: Change game speed
features.scope: Keep both players on the same selected simulation speed.

features.name: Place a building
features.scope: Place supported buildings with shared costs.

features.name: Move a building
features.scope: Move a supported building and preserve its shared identity.

features.name: Remove a building
features.scope: Remove a supported building and share its refund.

features.name: Copy a building
features.scope: Copy supported buildings, including after placement and undo/redo.

features.name: Undo and redo building placement
features.scope: Restore the building and scenery cleared by its placement.

features.name: Place individual scenery
features.scope: Place a supported scenery object with shared costs.

features.name: Move individual scenery
features.scope: Move one scenery object with both players seeing the same pose.

features.name: Remove individual scenery
features.scope: Remove one selected scenery object and share its refund.

features.name: Copy individual scenery
features.scope: Create a shared copy with its own identity.

features.name: Group scenery
features.scope: Group selected scenery objects together.

features.name: Copy a scenery group
features.scope: Copy the group and its member objects.

features.name: Ungroup scenery
features.scope: Ungroup either the original group or its copy.

features.name: Undo and redo grouping
features.scope: Restore group membership and names through shared history.

features.name: Erase one scenery object
features.scope: Use one eraser click and share the refund. Held strokes and large brushes are separate work.

features.name: Buy a region
features.scope: Share the region purchase and cost.

features.name: Change a region biome
features.scope: Share supported biome-style changes.

features.name: Change region levels
features.scope: Share the selected region level range.

features.name: Paint forest terrain
features.scope: Share a completed forest-terrain stamp.

features.name: Build a road
features.scope: Place a road, including a connection to an existing endpoint.

features.name: Remove a road
features.scope: Remove a road and share its refund.

features.name: Place a Class Trainer
features.scope: Place a Class Trainer in the shared world.

features.name: Move a Class Trainer
features.scope: Move an existing Class Trainer.

features.name: Remove a Class Trainer
features.scope: Remove an existing Class Trainer.

features.name: Place a Quest Giver
features.scope: Place a Quest Giver in the shared world.

features.name: Move a Quest Giver
features.scope: Move an existing Quest Giver.

features.name: Remove a Quest Giver
features.scope: Remove an existing Quest Giver.

features.name: Place an Elite monster
features.scope: Place an individual Elite monster while paused.

features.name: Move an Elite monster
features.scope: Move an individual Elite monster while paused.

features.name: Remove an Elite monster
features.scope: Remove an individual Elite monster while paused.

features.name: Create a quest
features.scope: Add a quest to a supported Quest Giver.

features.name: Remove a quest
features.scope: Remove a supported authored quest.

features.name: Rename a quest
features.scope: Share changes to its title.

features.name: Change quest counts
features.scope: Share changes to the required count.

features.name: Change quest rewards
features.scope: Share XP, gold and default-reward changes.

features.name: Choose a building destination
features.scope: Use a supported building as the quest destination.

features.name: Choose an NPC destination
features.scope: Use a supported NPC as the quest destination.

features.name: Research Bridges
features.scope: Start Bridges research, assign workers and unlock it together.

features.name: Continue a saved world
features.scope: Continue together from the Host's supported saved world.

features.name: Place a modular prefab
features.scope: Place a normal prefab with its selected theme. Other theme variants are not confirmed.

features.name: Add a modular block
features.scope: Use the normal block-adding tool.

features.name: Remove a modular block
features.scope: Use the left-click block-removal tool.

features.name: Add a modular entrance
features.scope: Use the normal entrance-adding tool.

features.name: Remove a modular entrance
features.scope: Use the normal entrance-removal tool.

features.name: Undo a modular layout edit
features.scope: The Client undoes a shared layout change.

features.name: Redo a modular layout edit
features.scope: The Host redoes that shared layout change.

features.name: Save a modular world
features.scope: Save the current world through the original game operation.

features.name: Reload a modular world
features.scope: Load the saved modular world on the Host.

features.name: Share the loaded modular world
features.scope: Load it on a Client that has already joined. This does not cover a later join.

features.name: Edit a loaded modular building
features.scope: Continue editing after the save assigns new object identities.

features.name: Progress modular construction
features.scope: Share developer assignment, movement, activation and job completion from the Host.

features.name: Remove a block with right-click
features.scope: Use right-click in block-building mode to request a shared removal.

features.name: Paint other terrain styles
features.scope: Share the other active terrain-paint styles.

features.name: Build and remove walls
features.scope: Share the active wall tool and its changes.

features.name: Draw and edit a district
features.scope: Share district shape, height and title placement.

features.name: Sell a region
features.scope: Share the ownership change and its financial effects.

features.name: Edit a monster zone
features.scope: Share zone shape, population settings and resets.

features.name: Share moving monster state
features.scope: Publish the Host's current moving actor state. This does not claim complete combat, respawn, Boss or visitor simulation.

features.name: Edit NPC properties
features.scope: Share the offered NPC property controls and affected quest references.

features.name: Place and remove a Dungeon portal
features.scope: Keep the exterior building, Dungeon identity and related references together.

features.name: Open and close Dungeon cells
features.scope: Share layout-cell edits and their history.

features.name: Paint Dungeon floors
features.scope: Share the offered Dungeon paint and theme controls.

features.name: Place Dungeon doors
features.scope: Share a door and its layout references.

features.name: Place Dungeon keys
features.scope: Preserve the shared key-to-door relationship.

features.name: Place Dungeon treasure
features.scope: Share treasure placement and references.

features.name: Change Dungeon lighting
features.scope: Share authored light and palette settings.

features.name: Configure Dungeon instances
features.scope: Share the offered instance configuration values. Creation, removal, entering and party lifecycles are not included in this claim.

features.name: Create and copy character types
features.scope: Share committed character-type creation, copy and variant membership commands. This does not claim every editor operation.

features.name: Edit a character costume
features.scope: Share committed model, body, color and animation choices.

features.name: Import a character PNG card
features.scope: Share a character-definition import through the original image-loading operation. This is not a world or map import.

features.name: Edit abilities
features.scope: Share offered ability costs, effects and membership changes.

features.name: Edit Boss phases
features.scope: Share offered phase and character-stat controls.

features.name: Place server-network nodes
features.scope: Share the offered server-network node operations.

features.name: Connect server-network cables
features.scope: Share endpoints, waypoints and connection removal.

features.name: Change game fees
features.scope: Share purchase, subscription and offered service prices.

features.name: Take and repay loans
features.scope: Share the loan state and resulting money changes.

features.name: Run advertising campaigns
features.scope: Share campaigns, budgets and financial effects.

features.name: Manage developers and Game Masters
features.scope: Share the implemented staff-assignment and job-state commands. This does not claim the whole staff simulation.

features.name: Publish MMO updates
features.scope: Share the implemented release-state and committed-project commands. This does not claim every MMO-update workflow.

features.name: Erase with held and large brushes
features.scope: Extend the confirmed single-click eraser scope.

features.name: Change an existing building theme
features.scope: Confirm separate theme editing and additional theme variants.

features.name: Join an already running world later
features.scope: Receive current state and continue without missing or repeating edits.

features.name: Rejoin after a disconnect
features.scope: Return to a continuing session after a Client restart or connection loss.

features.name: Share the full running simulation
features.scope: Cover interacting combat, quests, economy and lifecycle behavior together.

features.name: Build with four players
features.scope: Confirm the same gameplay with four participants.

features.name: Play in larger worlds
features.scope: Confirm gameplay and save behavior beyond the small-world scope.

features.name: Keep large sessions responsive
features.scope: Confirm performance under representative multiplayer load.

features.name: Play across separate Steam accounts
features.scope: Complete the online acceptance with separate accounts and machines.

beta17.summary: Scope carried in the current released build and its published feature list.

modular.summary: Eleven bounded Modular and saved-world actions confirmed in development on 22 October 2026. Not included in Beta17.

construction.summary: Running construction and right-click block removal are implemented and built; successful game behavior is not yet confirmed.

source.summary: Ordinary gameplay source routes are integrated. The exact feature scopes below are not yet confirmed end to end in game.

future.summary: No complete implementation or game acceptance is claimed for this scope.
